**Trust decision:** the post-login redirect target must stay a same-origin absolute path — enforced only in `SkyServer.Redirect` (`skymarshal/skyserver/skyserver.go:165-176`) which never percent-decodes first, so `%2F%2Fexample.com` becomes a protocol-relative `Location` at `:197`.

**pattern_fit:** `injection_only` — one changed function, one sink, both HTTP routes (`/sky/login` direct, `/sky/callback` via the signed state) funnel into it, no O2 site, no O8 route.

**Strongest lever:** the decode-layer differential between carriers plus the coupled legitimate encodings — a fix that unescapes once, or that rejects `%` outright, breaks `%20` pipeline paths and the legacy fly `%3F` redirect (`skymarshal/legacyserver/server.go:44`) while still missing triple-encoded state.

**Biggest red flag:** `single_site` — the fix is one hunk in one function, so the model is unlikely to fail on scope; the defence at `:172` was present and simply ineffective on encoded input.
